en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a large grassy clearing bordered by tall conifer trees. In the foreground and mid‑ground, numerous women and children in early 20th‑century clothing are sitting on the grass, on benches, or standing; some wear wide‑brimmed hats and light summer dresses. Simple play equipment such as seesaws is visible. The scene appears to be a leisure or spa park area. Text printed at the top left reads "HJO BAD. Barnängen".
